description:
An instrumentation engineer needs to configure combustible gas detectors for a chemical plant. Calculate the 'Low Alarm' setpoints for Methane, Propane, Hydrogen, and Acetone. 

1. Search for each chemical on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/).
2. Find the Lower Explosive Limit (LEL) in percent volume (use NIOSH values if multiple are listed; use lower value if range).
3. Calculate the safety setpoint as 10% of the LEL value.
4. Convert this setpoint from percent volume to parts per million (ppm). Note: 1% volume = 10,000 ppm.

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/alarm_setpoints.txt' with the following pipe-delimited format (one line per chemical):
Chemical Name | LEL (%) | Setpoint (ppm)

Example:
Ethane | 3.0 | 3000

Include all four chemicals in the report.
